description: The AI notebook that checks its own citations. Ask your PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files and every answer cites the exact page, with the quote checked against it. Open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux; works with your ChatGPT plan, your own API key (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek…) or a local model via Ollama.
summary: The AI notebook that checks its own citations. Ask your PDFs, Word files, slides and spreadsheets; answers cite the exact page. Open-source desktop app.
